articles.summary: MONDOVI, Wis., August 19, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Marten Transport, Ltd. (Nasdaq/GS:MRTN) announced today that Timothy Kohl, the Company’s Chief Executive Officer, has decided to retire from his role as Chief Executive Officer effective September 30, 2025.
